"""Tests for GalgameManager/Strings/resw_tool.py (ResourceManager)."""
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
RESW_TOOL_PATH = REPO_ROOT / "GalgameManager" / "Strings" / "resw_tool.py"


def _load_module():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("resw_tool", RESW_TOOL_PATH)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


resw_tool = _load_module()


RESW_TEMPLATE = """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<root>
  <data name="LoginTitle" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>{login}</value>
  </data>
  <data name="Logout" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>{logout}</value>
  </data>
</root>
"""


@pytest.fixture
def resource_dir(tmp_path):
    """Create a fake language-file tree with two languages."""
    (tmp_path / "en-US").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "zh-CN").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "en-US" / "Resources.resw").write_text(
        RESW_TEMPLATE.format(login="Login", logout="Log out"), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (tmp_path / "zh-CN" / "Resources.resw").write_text(
        RESW_TEMPLATE.format(login="登录", logout="登出"), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    # A directory without a Resources.resw file should be ignored.
    (tmp_path / "not-a-lang").mkdir()
    return tmp_path


def test_finds_only_language_dirs(resource_dir):
    rm = resw_tool.ResourceManager(resource_dir)
    assert set(rm.language_files.keys()) == {"en-US", "zh-CN"}


def test_parse_reads_key_values(resource_dir):
    rm = resw_tool.ResourceManager(resource_dir)
    data = rm._parse_resw_file(resource_dir / "en-US" / "Resources.resw")
    assert data == {"LoginTitle": "Login", "Logout": "Log out"}


def test_search_supports_wildcards(resource_dir):
    rm = resw_tool.ResourceManager(resource_dir)
    results = rm.search_keys("Log*")
    assert set(results.keys()) == {"LoginTitle", "Logout"}
    assert results["LoginTitle"] == {"en-US": "Login", "zh-CN": "登录"}


def test_search_no_match_returns_empty(resource_dir):
    rm = resw_tool.ResourceManager(resource_dir)
    assert rm.search_keys("Nonexistent*") == {}


def test_update_existing_key_round_trips(resource_dir):
    rm = resw_tool.ResourceManager(resource_dir)
    updated = rm.update_key("LoginTitle", {"en-US": "Sign in", "zh-CN": "登入"})
    assert set(updated) == {"en-US", "zh-CN"}

    # Re-read from disk to confirm the change was persisted.
    fresh = resw_tool.ResourceManager(resource_dir)
    results = fresh.search_keys("LoginTitle")
    assert results["LoginTitle"] == {"en-US": "Sign in", "zh-CN": "登入"}


def test_update_creates_new_key(resource_dir):
    rm = resw_tool.ResourceManager(resource_dir)
    updated = rm.update_key("BrandNew", {"en-US": "New value"})
    assert updated == ["en-US"]

    fresh = resw_tool.ResourceManager(resource_dir)
    assert fresh.search_keys("BrandNew")["BrandNew"] == {"en-US": "New value"}


def test_update_unknown_language_is_skipped(resource_dir):
    rm = resw_tool.ResourceManager(resource_dir)
    updated = rm.update_key("LoginTitle", {"fr-FR": "Connexion"})
    assert updated == []
